import os
from google.cloud import aiplatform

aiplatform.init(project="my-gcp-project", location="us-central1")

endpoint_id = "my-endpoint-id"
model_id = "my-model-id"

client_options = {"api_endpoint": "us-central1-aiplatform.googleapis.com"}
client = aiplatform.gapic.PredictionServiceClient(client_options=client_options)

endpoint = client.endpoint_path(project="my-gcp-project", location="us-central1", endpoint=endpoint_id)

instances = [
    {"content": "Translate this English text to French: I love machine learning."},
]

response = client.predict(name=endpoint, instances=instances)
